title: Prove Hadwiger-Nelson upper bound ≤ 7 via hexagonal 7-coloring

problemStatement.formal: Prove: ∃ c : Plane → Fin 7, ∀ p q : Plane, dist p q = 1 → c p ≠ c q
problemStatement.plain: The chromatic number of the unit distance graph on R² is at most 7. Prove via explicit hexagonal 7-coloring construction.
